reason: Free listing with flyers loaded for me is fine and costs nothing, so I might say yes to that, but I would not pay a monthly fee. My margins are thin and I cut any subscription that doesn't clearly bring in more people at the door.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? And how do I know the app will bring customers to my bar rather than just views?
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another bar in my area that the app filled their nights, plus a result tied to real people at the door, not just views.
